_comment: The six ClipSage subjects. Names are shown in the (English-only) interface. Each subject's lessons live in knowledge/<id>.json; 'tools' lists the practice simulators available in that subject; 'categories' names the topic groups.

subjects.name: Operating Systems
subjects.tagline: Processes, scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks and memory management

intro.en: Operating Systems explains how a computer shares its CPU, memory and devices between many programs safely and efficiently - from processes and threads to CPU scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks, paging and virtual memory.
intro.ru: Operating Systems samjhata hai ke computer apna CPU, memory aur devices bohat se programs mein mehfooz aur kaar-aamad tareeqe se kaise baant-ta hai - processes aur threads se le kar CPU scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks, paging aur virtual memory tak.

subjects.name: Machine Learning
subjects.tagline: Supervised and unsupervised algorithms, optimisation, NLP and the maths behind them

intro.en: Machine Learning teaches computers to learn patterns from data. This subject covers regression and classification algorithms, clustering, gradient descent, overfitting, text representation (TF-IDF, embeddings) and the probability, statistics and calculus they rely on.
intro.ru: Machine Learning computers ko data se patterns seekhna sikhata hai. Is subject mein regression aur classification algorithms, clustering, gradient descent, overfitting, text representation (TF-IDF, embeddings) aur un ki buniyad wali probability, statistics aur calculus shamil hain.

subjects.name: Linear Algebra
subjects.tagline: Vectors, matrices, systems of equations, vector spaces and eigenvalues

intro.en: Linear Algebra is the mathematics of vectors and matrices. It is the language of machine learning, computer graphics and engineering: solving systems of equations, understanding transformations and finding eigenvalues.
intro.ru: Linear Algebra vectors aur matrices ki mathematics hai. Yeh machine learning, computer graphics aur engineering ki zubaan hai: equations ke systems hal karna, transformations samajhna aur eigenvalues nikalna.

subjects.name: Compiler Construction
subjects.tagline: Lexical analysis, grammars, parsing and code generation

intro.en: Compiler Construction shows how source code becomes machine code: scanning characters into tokens, parsing them with grammars, checking meaning, and generating and optimising intermediate code.
intro.ru: Compiler Construction dikhata hai ke source code machine code kaise banta hai: characters ko tokens mein todna, grammars se unhein parse karna, maani check karna, aur intermediate code banana aur optimise karna.

subjects.name: Web Engineering
subjects.tagline: HTTP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, REST APIs and web security

intro.en: Web Engineering covers how the web works and how web applications are built: HTTP and networking basics, HTML structure, CSS layout, JavaScript and the DOM, REST APIs, sessions and security.
intro.ru: Web Engineering batata hai ke web kaise kaam karta hai aur web applications kaise banti hain: HTTP aur networking ki buniyad, HTML ka dhancha, CSS layout, JavaScript aur DOM, REST APIs, sessions aur security.

subjects.name: Computer Architecture
subjects.tagline: Number representation, ISA, pipelining, caches and performance

intro.en: Computer Architecture explains how a processor is organised and why it performs the way it does: how numbers are represented, how instructions execute, pipelining and hazards, the cache memory hierarchy and performance equations.
intro.ru: Computer Architecture samjhata hai ke processor kaise munazzam hota hai aur us ki performance aisi kyun hoti hai: numbers kaise represent hote hain, instructions kaise chalti hain, pipelining aur hazards, cache memory hierarchy aur performance equations.
